crossRefs.note: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the…
They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

translations.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
translations.bsb: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
translations.kjv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
translations.asv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod in the forepart thereof.
